statement.zh: 祭坛遗址仅有古典期，无前古典占用。
statement.en: Altar de Sacrificios has only Classic occupation and no Preclassic.

disclaimer: Hypothesis contrary to ceramic sequence publications that include Preclassic complexes; do not assert Classic-only occupation.
